items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: And they had one we called Fat. That wasn't his right name. I mean his gift name, but we called him... That was his nickname, you know. Fat, Fat O'Geeze. He used to play trumpet.

ctx.x: He played the trombone, the valve trombone. And Auguste, we called him by his family name. Auguste, that's the only... He played clarinet. That's all you called him. And they had one we called Fat. That wasn't his right name. I mean his gift name, but we called him... That was his nickname, you know. Fat, Fat O'Geeze. He used to play trumpet. And they had a young boy, but he didn't play in the band. The young brother, he didn't play in the band. He had a nice start.
